description: Disposición_residuos_sólidos is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by E.S.P. de Lebrija, Santander. Información de la disposición de residuos sólidos en el parque tecnológico ambiental san silvestre, cantidad por toneladas dispuestas en cada fecha. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher E.S.P. de Lebrija, Santander. Its tags are datos, residuos sólidos, recolección. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible. The portal shows 2026-08-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
